programme.title: Hellboy, film
programme.desc: U posljednjim danima Drugog svjetskog rata Nacisti pomoću crne magije pokušavaju preokrenuti tijek rata. Prilikom jedne seanse u kojoj pokušavaju probuditi zle bogove i dozvati ih na zemlju, savezničke postrojbe ih prekidaju, ali tom prilikom na Zemlju dolazi dijete demon kojeg saveznici usvajaju" i daju mu ime Hellboy. Hellboya odgaja profesor Trevor "Broom" Bruttenholm, ekspert za okultne pojave, a kad naraste dječak demon postaje agent Biroa za paranormalna istraživanja. Svaki put kad Zemljani imaju problema sa čudovištima, ovaj neobični specijalni agent kreće u akciju i svojom kamenom šakom rješava stvari.

programme.title: Prekrasan dan u susjedstvu, film
programme.desc: Novinar Lloyd Vogel (Matthew Rhys) zadužen je za stvaranje profila Freda Rogersa (Tom Hanks), tvorca i zvijezde uspješnog dječjeg programa „Susjedstvo g. Rogersa. Poslušno odlazi u studio gdje njegov subjekt snima svoju emisiju te uskoro zatim sjeda s njim i postavlja mu pronicljiva pitanja. Međutim, čini se da Fred ima na umu drukčiji plan. Intervjuirani iznenada postaje onaj koji intervjuira te počinje na neočekivane načine pomagati piscu.

programme.title: Izvorni kod, film
programme.desc: Pametan akcijski triler prepun fantastičnih obrata i uzbudljive neizvjesnosti! Odlikovani vojnik, kapetan Colter Stevens, budi se u tijeku nepoznatog čovjeka i otkriva da je dio misije pronalaženja bombaša iz prigradskog vlaka u Chicagu. U zadatku s kakvim se do sad nikad nije susreo, shvaća da je dio vladinog eksperimenta pod nazivom „Source Code“. Program je to koji mu omogućuje da prijeđe u identitet drugog čovjekov u zadnjih 8 minuta njegovog života. Dok drugi napad prijeti prouzročiti milijunske žrtve, Colter će iznova proživljavati incident kako bi prikupio što je više moguće informacija i tragova, sve dok ne otkrije tko stoji iza bombaškog napada i spriječi sljedeću tragediju.

programme.title: Larry Crowne, film
programme.desc: Nakon što izgubi posao, sredovječan čovjek ne zna što bi sa slobodnim vremenom kojeg odjednom ima i odlučuje se upisati na lokalni studij kako bi krenuo iz početka. Tamo postaje dijelom šarolike zajednice otpadnika i prezrenih koji pokušavaju za sebe stvoriti bolju budućnost. Ujedno se i zaljubljuje u profesoricu koja je izgubila žar za predavanjem kao i za svojim suprugom. Običan čovjek, koji je s pravom mislio da je zaglavio i da od života više ne može očekivati ništa, naučit će svoju lekciju – kad misliš da te je u životu zaobišlo sve ono što vrijedi, možeš pronaći razlog vrijedan življenja.

programme.title: Inferno, film
programme.desc: Dobitnik Oscara® Ron Howard vraća se režiji najnovijeg bestselera u milijarderskom serijalu o Robertu Landgonu Dana Browna („Da Vincijev kod), INFERNO, u kojem poznati simbolog (opet glumi Tom Hanks) slijedi tragove povezane sa samim velikim Danteom. Kad se Langdon probudi u talijanskoj bolnici s amnezijom, udružuje se sa Siennom Brooks (Felicity Jones), doktoricom za koju se nada da će mu pomoći vratiti sjećanja. Zajedno, oni se utrkuju diljem Europe i s vremenom kako bi spriječili luđaka da oslobodi globalni virus koji bi izbrisao pola svjetske populacije.

programme.title: 28 dana kasnije, film
programme.desc: Nakon provale u laboratorij u kojemu su vršena istraživanja na primatima, skupina aktivista oslobodi i majmune koji su, po riječima prestrašenog znanstvenika, zaraženi opasnim virusom. Nisu ga slušali, a ovo se zbilo 28 dana kasnije... Jim (Cillian Murphy) se budi iz kome u napuštenoj bolnici u Londonu. Tražeći pomoć šokiran luta praznom bolnicom te shvaća kako ni vani situacija nije znatno drugačija, sve dok na podu kapelice ne primijeti gomilu mrtvih tijela. Misleći kako je konačno nekoga pronašao, Jim se suoči sa svećenikom poludjelog pogleda, nevjerojatne brzine i krvavih očiju, od kojega ipak uspije pobjeći. Iz te ga situacije spase Selena (Naomie Harris) i Mark (Noah Huntley), koji ga odvedu na sigurno i objasne mu što se sve zbilo dok je on bio u komi. Pojavila se opasna infekcija koja se prenosi krvlju i cijela je Britanija preplavljena zaraženim zombijima. Njih se troje ipak usuđuju krenuti u potragu za Jimovim roditeljima... Jedan od najboljih novijih filmova o zombijima, ili njima sličnim napasnicima, "28 dana kasnije" uspješan je upravo zbog toga što je klasičnoj tematici pristupio na originalan način i s puno nadahnuća. Za razliku od usporenih zombija u filmovima iz šezdesetih i sedamdesetih godina prošlog stoljeća, ovdje oni posjeduju ogromnu brzinu pa je jeza onih koji pokušavaju pobjeći nemjerljivo veća, što slavni redatelj Danny Boyle lakoćom prenosi i na publiku. Poznati književnik Alex Garland napisao je scenarij u kojem vješto isprepliće akcijske scene horora s moralnim pitanjima, ni jednog trena ne popuštajući u zabavljanju gledatelja. Glavnu ulogu tumači Cillian Murphy, kojemu su se nakon ovoga sjajnog nastupa otvorila vrata skupih holivudskih produkcija.

programme.title: Elita, reality show
programme.desc: Novinari najčitanijih novina i portala se iz studija uključuju u "Elitu" i učesnicima postavljaju pitanja u vezi sa njihovim postupcima, odnosima i događajima u rijalitiju.

programme.title: Elita, reality show
programme.desc: Novinari najčitanijih novina i portala se iz studija uključuju u "Elitu" i učesnicima postavljaju pitanja u vezi sa njihovim postupcima, odnosima i događajima u rijalitiju.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Aktuelno, premijerno, za korak ispred svih - Premijera je zbog toga najgledanija kratka forma vesti o poznatima. Ne postoji javna ličnost do koje premijerna ekipa ne može doći, a nijedan gradski događaj ne može proći bez njih. I u novoj sezoni najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde govoriće pred Premijerinim kamerama, ali kroz nove rubrike: Ličnost dana, VIP online, Sa beogradskih ulica i Ispred premijernog objektiva.

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Sudbina, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Pinkove zvezde
programme.desc: Jedno od najgledanijih i najvoljenijih muzičkih takmičenja na Balkanu - "Pinkove zvezde" - vraća se na velika vrata. Nova sezona počinje ove subote, 20. septembra u 21h na TV Pink, a publika može da očekuje uzbudljiviju, dinamičniju i emotivniju sezonu nego ikada do sada. Subotnje večeri ponovo će biti rezervisane za muziku koja pokreće, talente koje čeka uspeh i nastupe koji postaju viralni u roku od nekoliko sati. Gledaoci iz celog regiona imaće priliku da prate kako se pred njima rađaju nove zvezde - mladi umetnici koji svojim glasom, harizmom i upornošću žele da osvoje tron najprestižnijeg muzičkog takmičenja. U žiriju nas ove sezone očekuje nikad jača i šarenolikija postava, koja obećava pravu muzičku dinamiku, ali i mnogo zabave, suza, smeha i komentara koji će se dugo prepričavati: Jelena Karleuša - muzička diva i ikona stila, poznata po britkom jeziku i nemilosrdnoj iskrenosti; Zorica Brunclik - živa legenda narodne muzike, čije reči nose težinu, a iskustvo obuhvata decenije umetničkog rada; Dragan Stojković Bosanac - maestralni harmonikaš i muzički producent, koji zna kako da iz mladog pevača izvuče maksimum; Viki Miljković - popularna pevačica i mentor, prepoznatljiva po ljudskom pristupu, velikoj harizmi i dugogodišnjem iskustvu u radu s talentima i Desingerica - urbani fenomen i predstavnik nove muzičke generacije, koji će doneti svežinu, brzinu i direktan uvid u aktuelne muzičke tokove. Pet potpuno različitih pogleda, ukusa i kriterijuma, ali svi sa istim ciljem - da pronađu najveću novu muzičku zvezdu regiona.„Pinkove zvezde vodiće Ognjen Amidžić i Bojana Lazić. Njih dvoje će gledaoce voditi kroz svaku emisiju, pružajući ekskluzivne uvide, intervjue i emocije koje se ne mogu sakriti. Nova sezona donosi vizuelno i tehnički najmoćnije izdanje do sada - scenografija kakva se viđa samo u najvećim svetskim šou-programima, besprekoran zvuk, kao i pažljivo zabeležena svaka emocija na licima kandidata."Pinkove zvezde" nisu samo takmičenje - to je platforma koja je pokrenula karijere brojnih sadašnjih muzičkih zvezda. Ova emisija već godinama unazad pronalazi talentovane mlade ljude i pretvara ih u popularne izvođače koji pune hale, arene i trending liste.Ljubitelji dobre muzike, kvalitetnog zabavnog programa i iskrenih emocija - ne propustite premijernu epizodu nove sezone u subotu, 20. septembra u 21h. POČINJE SPEKTAKL! ZVEZDE SE RAĐAJU!

programme.desc: U novoj sezoni u „Magazinu In vas očekuju smeh, suze, emotivne ispovesti i priznanja poznatih ličnosti - i prikaz života bez filtera. Kako bi svake sezone bila inovativna i opravdala poverenje milionskog auditorijuma, Sanja pomno prati svetske trendove i implementira ih u svoju autorsku emisiju, zbog čega je u domovima širom regiona subotnje popodne rezervisano upravo za „Magazin In.

Planet prirodnih čuda
programme.desc: Spektakularna oda najvećim prirodnim čudima našeg planeta, mjestima koja zaista oduzimaju dah, a istodobno su nevjerojatan izazov za ljude koji na njima žive. Nakon velikog uspjeha prve sezone ove BBC-eve serije, nova sezona donosi još ekstremnih primjera kako ljudi preživljavaju, pa čak i odnose pobjede, u nekima od najnesmiljenijih uvjeta na Zemlji. Golemi planinski lanci, neprobojne kišne šume i golema ledena prostranstva... To su mjesta na kojima je priroda u svojem najmoćnijem, najljepšem, a katkad i najnemilosrdnijem izdanju. Kombinirajući najbolja znanstvena dostignuća i umijeće snimanja prirode, prekrasna fotografija u ovoj seriji pruža gledateljima priliku da istinski dožive te nevjerojatne krajolike i urone u začuđujuće priče njihovih stanovnika. Serija otkriva kako se ljudi koji su se prilagodili ovim mjestima i evoluirali s njima služe nevjerojatnim vještinama, domišljatošću i hrabrošću u borbi za opstanak. Priče uključuju kauboje koji zamjenjuju konje helikopterima i opasno nisko lete kako bi upravljali stadima u nepreglednim i nemilosrdnim predjelima australske divljine te Eskimke koje u arktičkim predjelima Kanade izlažu živote pogibelji kako bi skupile dagnje ispod pokretnog morskog leda koje će biti prilog uz tuljanovo meso.

Golemi planinski lanci, neprobojne kišne šume i golema ledena prostranstva... To su mjesta na kojima je priroda u svojem najmoćnijem, najljepšem, a katkad i najnemilosrdnijem izdanju. Kombinirajući najbolja znanstvena dostignuća i umijeće snimanja prirode, prekrasna fotografija u ovoj seriji pruža gledateljima priliku da istinski dožive te nevjerojatne krajolike i urone u začuđujuće priče njihovih stanovnika. Serija otkriva kako se ljudi koji su se prilagodili ovim mjestima i evoluirali s njima služe nevjerojatnim vještinama, domišljatošću i hrabrošću u borbi za opstanak. Priče uključuju kauboje koji zamjenjuju konje helikopterima i opasno nisko lete kako bi upravljali stadima u nepreglednim i nemilosrdnim predjelima australske divljine te Eskimke koje u arktičkim predjelima Kanade izlažu živote pogibelji kako bi skupile dagnje ispod pokretnog morskog leda koje će biti prilog uz tuljanovo meso.

programme.title: Di là dal fiume tra gli alberi
Waldbühne 2003 - A Gershwin Night
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. This year Seiji Ozawa and the Berliner Philharmoniker perform works by George Gershwin. The Waldbühne in Berlin is one of the most attractive outdoor amphitheatres in Europe and home to the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. With a 20, 000-seat capacity, these events are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world. In 2003, Seiji Ozawa and the Berliner Philharmoniker perform works by George Gershwin with the jazz pianist Marcus Roberts and his Trio as special guests. Their album Gershwin For Lovers stayed in the Top 10 on Billboard’s jazz chart for half a year. Together they created a magical fusion of classical music and jazz bringing an imaginative mix of styles into the swing of Gershwin’s music.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode of Discovering Masterpieces presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Brahms' Symphony No. 1 as part of the 2014 BBC Proms. Also included in this performance is the U.K. premiere of Jörg Widmann's Flûte en suite featuring soloist Joshua Smith. Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in this performance of Brahms' Symphony No. 1. Few symphonic works have taken longer to come into fruition than Brahms' first. The composer had basic ideas about this work as early as 1855 when he was just 22 years old. It saw numerous revisions before its completion, as Brahms was encouraged by his peers, most notably Clara Schumann and musicologist Philipp Spitta, to press forward despite the fear of living in Beethoven's shadow. Also included in this performance is the U.K. premiere of Jörg Widmann's Flûte en suite featuring soloist Joshua Smith. This performance was recorded as part of the 2014 BBC proms season at The Royal Albert Hall in London, U.K.

This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Mozart - Gran partita - IV. Menuetto. Allegretto
programme.desc: Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece’s duration is longer than the composer’s other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Anton Arensky - Suite no.1, op.15 - III. Polonaise
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Von Weber - Overture to Oberon
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. programme.title: Fischer conducts Prokofiev and Stravinsky
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. On the program are Prokofiev's Ouverture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34 and Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63, and Stravinsky's Jeu de Cartes and Firebird Suite No. 2. Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23 in A major
programme.desc: Zoltán Kocsis (1952-2016) performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488. The Virtuosi de Praha are conducted by Jirí Belohlávek in a concert that took place in Prague in 1999. Zoltán Kocsis (1952-2016) performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488. The Virtuosi de Praha are conducted by Jirí Belohlávek in a concert that took place in Prague in 1999. Mozart completed the concerto on March 2, 1786, around the time his Le nozze di Figaro premiered. The final rondo puts Mozart’s musical humour on full display. Themes are tossed back and forth between the soloist and orchestra as they chase each other through unexpected key changes.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050. Remarkably, the harpsichord appears as a solo instrument here, along with the flute and violin, rather than as an accompanying instrument. The piece is therefore considered one of Bach’s very first keyboard concertos.

programme.title: Bach - Motets
programme.desc: This festive concert from the Gethsemanekirche in Berlin marks the 60th anniversary of the RIAS Kammerchor. Under the new chief conductor Hans-Christoph Rademann, the orchestras perform famous Motets by Johann Sebastian Bach. This festive concert from the Gethsemanekirche in Berlin marks the 60th anniversary of the RIAS Kammerchor. Under the baton of the new chief conductor Hans-Christoph Rademann, the RIAS Kammerchor and the Akademie für Alte Musik Berlin perform famous Motets by Johann Sebastian Bach, interspersed with some fine instrumental works of the composer. Founded in 1948, the choir enjoys today a worldwide reputation as one of the best ensembles of its kind. The choir sings „Der Geist hilft unser Schwachheit auf, Motet BWV 226, Sinfonia from Cantata BWV 146; „Ich lasse dich nicht, du segnest mich denn BWV Anh. 159; Concerto from Cantata BWV 35; „Jesu, meine Freude BWV 227 and Sinfonia from Cantata BWV 188.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Messiaen a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sara Gouzy (France, 1991) and pianist Seri Dan (South Korea, 1992) perform works by Claude Debussy, Franz Schubert, Olivier Messiaen, Sergei Rachmaninoff, Francis Poulenc, Bart Visman, and Hugo Wolf, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Soprano Sara Gouzy (France, 1991) and pianist Seri Dan (South Korea, 1992) perform ‘Chevaux de bois’ from Claude Debussy’s Ariettes oubliées, L. 63; Franz Schubert’s An den Mond, Op. 57, No. 3, D. 193; ‘Le collier’ from Olivier Messiaen’s Poèmes pour Mi; ‘Margaritki’ (Daisies) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; ‘Quelle aventure!’, and ‘La reine de coeur’ from Francis Poulenc’s La courte paille; Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold; and ‘Wie Lange schon war immer mein Verlangen’, and ‘Ich hab’ in Penna einen Liebsten wohnen’ from Hugo Wolf’s Italienisches Liederbuch, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: In this documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed. The piece has the character of an appeal from the very start, when the four-note fate motif casts a spell on listeners. Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed. The piece has the character of an appeal from the very start, when the four-note fate motif casts a spell on listeners. The German musicologist Armin Koch analyses the work, while the German Beethoven expert Wulf Konold illustrates the ingenious variations of the fate motif on piano, and also explains other features of this magnificent work.

programme.title: Liszt - Piano Concerto No. 1 in E-flat, S.124
programme.desc: Dazzling, virtuosic, and spectacular: no other adjectives are better suited to describe the piano music of Franz Liszt. Enjoy a sparkling performance of Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in E flat major by the incredible piano virtuoso Russian Daniil Trifonov, with Kent Nagano conducting the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra. As an encore, Trifonov performs Reflets dans l'eau from Debussy's Images. The orchestra closes this concert with a rendition of Mahler's Symphony No. 7. Recorded at the Charles Bronfman Auditorium, Tel Aviv, in 2014.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Prelude, Op.23, No.7
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021. Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff’s piano transcription of J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 3 in E major; a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39); Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5); Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7; and Rachmaninoff’s transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand". Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, 2017. Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 3, 8 & 11
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 3 in D major, Op. 18 No. 3; String Quartet No. 11 in F minor, Op. 95, Quartetto Serioso; and String Quartet No. 8 in E minor, Op. 59, No. 2, "Razumovsky". This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 23, 2020.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: In this 30-minute film, children have their say; boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recount Mozart's life in their own words. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children. The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland. In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s 7 variations after "The Magic Flute"; Robert Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 73; Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction & Polonaise, Op. 3; ‘Lerchengesang’ (No. 2) from Johannes Brahms’s 4 Gesänge, Op. 70; and ‘Largo’ from Chopin’s Cello Sonata in G minor, Op. 65. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.

programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Among his five concertos, Violin Concerto No. 4 is one of the best-known. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris. The work gained popularity after appearing on the soundtrack to the 2002 Roman Polanski film The Pianist, where it is played by Janusz Olejniczak. Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris. The main section of the ballade is built from two main themes which return in different keys after which a thundering chord introduces the Presto con fuoco, which eventually ends the piece in a fiery double octave scale run down the keyboard. The work gained popularity after appearing on the soundtrack to the 2002 Roman Polanski film The Pianist, where it is played by Janusz Olejniczak.

programme.title: Giselle
programme.desc: Choreographed by Charles Jude, the ballet Giselle tells the story of a lovely peasant girl by the same name. Performed at the Opéra national de Bordeaux in 2011, it features dancers Oxana Kucheruk (Giselle) and Igor Yebra (Albrecht). Choreographed by Charles Jude, the ballet Giselle by Jean Coralli and Jules Perrot, with music by Adolphe Adam, tells the story of a lovely peasant girl by the same name. Giselle was first presented at Théâtre de l'Académie Royale de Musique in Salle Le Peletier in Paris on June 28, 1841. The story is set in the Rhineland of the Middle Ages during the grape harvest. Giselle falls in love with Albrecht, the Duke of Silesia. Hilarion, a gamekeeper, is also in love with Giselle and warns the girl against trusting a stranger, but she refuses to listen. Albrecht and Giselle dance a love duet, with Giselle picking the petals from a daisy to divine her lover's sincerity. When Giselle discovers Albrecht is going to marry Bathilde, she dies of a broken heart. Performed at the Opéra national de Bordeaux in 2011, this ballet features dancers Oxana Kucheruk (Giselle) and Igor Yebra (Albrecht).

programme.title: Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: Montréal native Marc-André Hamelin is internationally renowned for his musical virtuosity and refined pianism. He plays works by Haydn (Piano sonata in E major), Chopin (Piano sonata No.3), Debussy (‘Préludes’, book two), Hamelin (Etude No.7) and others. We live in a "renaissance of the piano, as the New York Times has recently put it. With virtuosic flair and an eagerness to expand the repertoire, a new generation of pianists has revitalized the instrument’s appeal. In addition to the usual classics, they perform formerly scorned works or discover neglected composers. Legato is a series dedicated to presenting some of this new movement's most fascinating pianists - their individual approaches, their fresh ideas and their music. Each episode portrays an artist and shows an aspect of the world of the piano. The sum of these portraits provides viewers with an overall picture of the art of the pianist. Montréal native Marc-André Hamelin is internationally renowned for his musical virtuosity and refined pianism. The Times described one of his performances as ultimate perfection. He plays works by Haydn (Piano sonata in E major), Chopin (Piano sonata No. 3), Debussy (‘Préludes’, book two), Hamelin (Etude No. 7), as well as two short pieces by Gershwin (‘Do, Do, Do’ and ‘Liza’).

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: A symphony of tender, transparent beauty and comforting, childlike simplicity. The work's unique portrayal of paradise through a child's perspective offers a refreshing contrast to the more complex and often turbulent works in Mahler's output. Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. This program features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4. Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4. This lesser-known concerto saw three separate iterations throughout the composer’s life and is characterized by bold chromaticism and a distinctly Jazz-like quality. Luisi and de la Salle have prior experience with this piece, having previously performed and recorded it together. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047. This piece features trumpet, violin, recorder, and oboe solos. Especially outstanding are the high, virtuoso trumpet parts.

programme.title: Mozart - Concerto for Violin No. 4 - II. Andante
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Among his five concertos, Violin Concerto No. 4 is one of the best-known. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Arnold Schönberg’s Pelleas et Melisande, Op.5. Recorded 2006 at Musikverein Vienna. The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication. Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Schönberg’s Pelleas und Melisande, Op. 5. The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in Vienna in 1986, by Abbado’s initiative. The orchestra's high level of artistic quality and its international success have moved important conductors and soloists to work with the ensemble.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform works by Franz Schubert, Claude Debussy, Miroslav Srnka, Alphons Diepenbrock, Carl Loewe, Alexander von Zemlinksy, Reynaldo Hahn, Ralph Vaughan Williams, Wolfgang Rihm, Viktor Ullmann, and Robert Schumann, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Il modo di prender morale’ from Franz Schubert’s Drei Lieder, Op. 83, D. 902; ‘Le faune’ from Claude Debussy’s Fêtes galantes II, L. 114; ‘Du alte Ananasbirne’ from Miroslav Srnka’s Dreizehn Lieder; Alphons Diepenbrock’s Simeons lofzang, RC 120; Carl Loewe’s Odins Meeresritt, Op. 118; ‘Nach dem Gewitter’ from Alexander von Zemlinksy’s Acht Lieder, Op. 5; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Sept chansons grises; ‘Silent noon’ from Ralph Vaughan Williams’ The house of life; ‘Ich mag euch alle nicht’ from Wolfgang Rihm’s Neue Alexanderlieder; ‘Betrunken’ from Viktor Ullmann’s Liederbuch des Hafis, Op. 30; and Robert Schumann’s Belsazar, Op. 57, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Das Rheingold is the prologue to Wagner's Ring cycle. With beautiful orchestration and an unerring sense of the dramatic, the first opera explains how the Rhinedaughters came to lose the Ring and how it fell into the hands of Alberich the Nibelung. Das Rheingold is the prologue to Richard Wagner's Ring Cycle. This rendition (2003) features the Staatsoper Stuttgart under the baton of conductor Lothar Zagrosek. Tonight’s soloists are Wolfgang Probst, Motti Kastón, Bernhard Schneider, Robert Künzli, Esa Ruuttunen, Eberhard Francesco Lorenz and Roland Bracht. With beautiful orchestration and an unerring sense of the dramatic, the first opera explains how the Rhinedaughters lost the Ring and how it fell into the hands of Alberich the Nibelung; Wotan, king of the gods; and Fafner the giant. Each time it changes hands, the Ring confers upon the bearer a curse and this pattern is set to continue until it is restored to its rightful owners, the daughters of the Rhine.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Magazin In
programme.desc: U novoj sezoni u „Magazinu In vas očekuju smeh, suze, emotivne ispovesti i priznanja poznatih ličnosti - i prikaz života bez filtera. Kroz svoju autorsku emisiju, Sanja Marinković će nastaviti da javne ličnosti pita sve ono što biste i vi želeli da znate, i baviće se zanimljivom, ali ponekad i škakljivom temom muško-ženskih odnosa. Kako bi svake sezone bila inovativna i opravdala poverenje milionskog auditorijuma, Sanja pomno prati svetske trendove i implementira ih u svoju autorsku emisiju, zbog čega je u domovima širom regiona subotnje popodne rezervisano upravo za „Magazin In.

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. programme.title: Pinkove zvezde
programme.desc: Jedno od najgledanijih i najvoljenijih muzičkih takmičenja na Balkanu - "Pinkove zvezde" - vraća se na velika vrata. Nova sezona počinje ove subote, 20. septembra u 21h na TV Pink, a publika može da očekuje uzbudljiviju, dinamičniju i emotivniju sezonu nego ikada do sada. Subotnje večeri ponovo će biti rezervisane za muziku koja pokreće, talente koje čeka uspeh i nastupe koji postaju viralni u roku od nekoliko sati. Gledaoci iz celog regiona imaće priliku da prate kako se pred njima rađaju nove zvezde - mladi umetnici koji svojim glasom, harizmom i upornošću žele da osvoje tron najprestižnijeg muzičkog takmičenja. U žiriju nas ove sezone očekuje nikad jača i šarenolikija postava, koja obećava pravu muzičku dinamiku, ali i mnogo zabave, suza, smeha i komentara koji će se dugo prepričavati: Jelena Karleuša - muzička diva i ikona stila, poznata po britkom jeziku i nemilosrdnoj iskrenosti; Zorica Brunclik - živa legenda narodne muzike, čije reči nose težinu, a iskustvo obuhvata decenije umetničkog rada; Dragan Stojković Bosanac - maestralni harmonikaš i muzički producent, koji zna kako da iz mladog pevača izvuče maksimum; Viki Miljković - popularna pevačica i mentor, prepoznatljiva po ljudskom pristupu, velikoj harizmi i dugogodišnjem iskustvu u radu s talentima i Desingerica - urbani fenomen i predstavnik nove muzičke generacije, koji će doneti svežinu, brzinu i direktan uvid u aktuelne muzičke tokove. Pet potpuno različitih pogleda, ukusa i kriterijuma, ali svi sa istim ciljem - da pronađu najveću novu muzičku zvezdu regiona.„Pinkove zvezde vodiće Ognjen Amidžić i Bojana Lazić. Njih dvoje će gledaoce voditi kroz svaku emisiju, pružajući ekskluzivne uvide, intervjue i emocije koje se ne mogu sakriti. Nova sezona donosi vizuelno i tehnički najmoćnije izdanje do sada - scenografija kakva se viđa samo u najvećim svetskim šou-programima, besprekoran zvuk, kao i pažljivo zabeležena svaka emocija na licima kandidata."Pinkove zvezde" nisu samo takmičenje - to je platforma koja je pokrenula karijere brojnih sadašnjih muzičkih zvezda. Ova emisija već godinama unazad pronalazi talentovane mlade ljude i pretvara ih u popularne izvođače koji pune hale, arene i trending liste.Ljubitelji dobre muzike, kvalitetnog zabavnog programa i iskrenih emocija - ne propustite premijernu epizodu nove sezone u subotu, 20. septembra u 21h. POČINJE SPEKTAKL! ZVEZDE SE RAĐAJU!

programme.title: Ljubav i mržnja, serija
programme.desc: Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista "Jutarnja Zvezda", kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: Preživeti Beograd, serija
programme.desc: Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u velikigrad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Paparazzo lov
programme.desc: U sredu 15. oktobra počinje nova, 17. po redu sezona emisije "Paparazzo lov". Novinari - istraživači prate živote poznatih ličnosti i ove godine i otkrivaju sve njihove skrivene tajne. Tako ćete već u prvoj epizodi videti nekoliko ekskluzivnih priča dugo čuvanih od javnosti. Biće tu i retrospektiva snimaka nastalih tokom leta na crnogorskom, hrvatskom i grčkom primorju. A otrkićemo i nepoznate detalje o aktuelnim učesnicima rijalitija Elita. Voditeljka ove sezone biće Katarina Nikolić. A emisija ide pod sloganom - gledajte samo na Pinku sredom u 23 časa. Nema reprize niti će epizode biti okačene na platformama.

programme.desc: U novoj sezoni u „Magazinu In vas očekuju smeh, suze, emotivne ispovesti i priznanja poznatih ličnosti - i prikaz života bez filtera. Kroz svoju autorsku emisiju, Sanja Marinković će nastaviti da javne ličnosti pita sve ono što biste i vi želeli da znate, i baviće se zanimljivom, ali ponekad i škakljivom temom muško-ženskih odnosa. Kako bi svake sezone bila inovativna i opravdala poverenje milionskog auditorijuma, Sanja pomno prati svetske trendove i implementira ih u svoju autorsku emisiju, zbog čega je u domovima širom regiona subotnje popodne rezervisano upravo za „Magazin In.

programme.title: Moj tata na određeno vreme, film
programme.desc: Podstanarske avanture nesretnog nastavnika nastavljaju se u filmu "Moj tata na određeno vrijeme", drugom dijelu iznimno uspješne komedije "Rad na određeno vrijeme". Samohrana majka Svetlana, njen dvanaestogodišnji sin i vječito privremeno zaposleni Siniša suočavaju se s novim neprilikama kada se u Svetlanin život vrati njen bivši muž. Iako je odlučio zaprositi Svetlanu, Siniša je obeshrabren takvim razvojem situacije, čemu ne pomaže ni njegov neveliki uspjeh u potrazi za stalnim poslom. Pretjerano revan u nagovaranju članice komisije za posao, čini se da nastavnik nema šanse mjeriti se s bogatim bivšim mužem, a jedini koji mu može pomoći tek je Svetlanin sin. Potaknut ogromnim uspjehom u kinima bivše države, redatelj Milan Jelić odlučio je snimiti i drugi dio svog "Rada na određeno vrijeme2 i, što je prava rijetkost, napravio je jednako zabavan, duhovit i uzbudljiv film. Gotovo cijeli pobjednički tim, od ko-scenarista Predraga Perišića do superzvijezda YU kinematografije Ljubiše Samardžića, Milene Dravić i Velimira Živojinovića, okupio se stvarajući ovu komediju, uz pomoć velikog Borisa Dvornika, koji opuštenim nastupom izaziva dodatne salve gledateljskog smijeha. Iako snimljen pod imperativom kvalitetne zabave, "Moj tata na određeno vrijeme", baš poput svog prethodnika, istovremeno uspijeva i precizno ocrtati svakodnevni život običnih ljudi usred posljednjeg desetljeća postojanja Jugoslavije.

programme.desc: U novoj sezoni u „Magazinu In vas očekuju smeh, suze, emotivne ispovesti i priznanja poznatih ličnosti - i prikaz života bez filtera. Kroz svoju autorsku emisiju, Sanja Marinković će nastaviti da javne ličnosti pita sve ono što biste i vi želeli da znate, i baviće se zanimljivom, ali ponekad i škakljivom temom muško-ženskih odnosa. Kako bi svake sezone bila inovativna i opravdala poverenje milionskog auditorijuma, Sanja pomno prati svetske trendove i implementira ih u svoju autorsku emisiju, zbog čega je u domovima širom regiona subotnje popodne rezervisano upravo za „Magazin In.

programme.desc: Već znamo da je "Agencija za sve i svašta" vlasotinačko preduzeće koje rešava sve probleme svojih klijenata. Osnivač i vlasnik firme je Spiridon Don Karamarković, nekadašnji pripadnik Legije stranaca, ekspert za sva pitanja i najškrtiji gazda na svetu. programme.title: Pinkove zvezde
programme.desc: Jedno od najgledanijih i najvoljenijih muzičkih takmičenja na Balkanu - "Pinkove zvezde" - vraća se na velika vrata. Nova sezona počinje ove subote, 20. septembra u 21h na TV Pink, a publika može da očekuje uzbudljiviju, dinamičniju i emotivniju sezonu nego ikada do sada. Subotnje večeri ponovo će biti rezervisane za muziku koja pokreće, talente koje čeka uspeh i nastupe koji postaju viralni u roku od nekoliko sati. Gledaoci iz celog regiona imaće priliku da prate kako se pred njima rađaju nove zvezde - mladi umetnici koji svojim glasom, harizmom i upornošću žele da osvoje tron najprestižnijeg muzičkog takmičenja. U žiriju nas ove sezone očekuje nikad jača i šarenolikija postava, koja obećava pravu muzičku dinamiku, ali i mnogo zabave, suza, smeha i komentara koji će se dugo prepričavati: Jelena Karleuša - muzička diva i ikona stila, poznata po britkom jeziku i nemilosrdnoj iskrenosti; Zorica Brunclik - živa legenda narodne muzike, čije reči nose težinu, a iskustvo obuhvata decenije umetničkog rada; Dragan Stojković Bosanac - maestralni harmonikaš i muzički producent, koji zna kako da iz mladog pevača izvuče maksimum; Viki Miljković - popularna pevačica i mentor, prepoznatljiva po ljudskom pristupu, velikoj harizmi i dugogodišnjem iskustvu u radu s talentima i Desingerica - urbani fenomen i predstavnik nove muzičke generacije, koji će doneti svežinu, brzinu i direktan uvid u aktuelne muzičke tokove. Pet potpuno različitih pogleda, ukusa i kriterijuma, ali svi sa istim ciljem - da pronađu najveću novu muzičku zvezdu regiona.„Pinkove zvezde vodiće Ognjen Amidžić i Bojana Lazić. Njih dvoje će gledaoce voditi kroz svaku emisiju, pružajući ekskluzivne uvide, intervjue i emocije koje se ne mogu sakriti. Nova sezona donosi vizuelno i tehnički najmoćnije izdanje do sada - scenografija kakva se viđa samo u najvećim svetskim šou-programima, besprekoran zvuk, kao i pažljivo zabeležena svaka emocija na licima kandidata."Pinkove zvezde" nisu samo takmičenje - to je platforma koja je pokrenula karijere brojnih sadašnjih muzičkih zvezda. Ova emisija već godinama unazad pronalazi talentovane mlade ljude i pretvara ih u popularne izvođače koji pune hale, arene i trending liste.Ljubitelji dobre muzike, kvalitetnog zabavnog programa i iskrenih emocija - ne propustite premijernu epizodu nove sezone u subotu, 20. septembra u 21h. POČINJE SPEKTAKL! ZVEZDE SE RAĐAJU!

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona
programme.desc: 2022 - Salón Internacional Barcelona A day at...International Barcelona Boat Show.During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship, 2025 - - GP of China - Shangai
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2023 - GP Lake of Toba - Endurance 1 ( Karo Cup) After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: After making their debut in indomitable style in 2014, the unique flying catamarans literally "took off" on their first European Circuit in 2015. Building on the success of the America's Cup foiling catamarans, the GC32 takes the thrill of foiling to an extraordinary performance level in a fiercely fought five stage circuit raced across five iconic venues in Italy, Spain and France.

programme.title: FUN FOIL FEST - España Mar Menor, 2023 - Los Alcázares
programme.desc: High doses of action, excitement and sporting spectacle on the shores of the Mar Menor.It is a competition that brings together all the nautical disciplines of foil type (consisting of a keel shaped like a mini-airplane placed under the board). A spectacle of action and color, right here.

programme.title: Vendée Globe Weekly Highlights, 2024/2025 - - Review
programme.desc: To date, the VENDÉE GLOBE is the only solo sailing race around the world that is non-stop and without assistance. The event followed in the wake of the Golden Globe that initiated the first circumnavigation of this type via the three capes (Good Hope, Leeuwin and Horn) in 1968. 44,996 kilometres, or 24,296 miles. That is the circumference of the Earth. The Vendée Globe accomplishes in 74 days this planetary voyage as participants sail down the Atlantic, across the Indian and face the challenges of the Pacific Ocean. The public refer to this arduous competition as the Everest of the seas, and this 9th edition will see 33 contenders depart from Les Sables-d’ Olonne to take part in a life changing competition.Follow the highlights of what happens weekly in the Vendée Globe as challengers sail to the journey of their lives.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut, 2016
programme.desc: One month before the Vendée Globe 2016, the best Imoca skippers were able to test their boat for the last time during the sixth edition of the Défi Azimut. Every year, this festive weekend provides an opportunity for all stakeholders in ocean sailing to see the Imoca 60 boats and to meet their skipper on the dock.

programme.title: Inside Sailing
programme.desc: Inside Sailing contains highlights from top sailing and yachting events around the world. It is a documentary show which educates the audience about the secrets of sailing, presents several exciting sea-side locations and offers a flavor of yachting lifestyle.

programme.title: Sails In Sardinia
programme.desc: Sails in Sardinia takes us to the beautiful Italian island of Sardinia, the sescond largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, to visit the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda, in Porto Cervo. Known for being visited by the rich and famous, it also has a unique sailing history. We will get the true essence of competitive sailing at the Audi Settimana Delle Bocche, where the last leg of the TP52 Super Series is being held. We are meeting Ricardo Bonadeo, Commodore of the yacht club, to understand better how the 1967 non-profit organization has become today a world's leading organizer in international sailing events. Join Andi Van Zyl as she heads to the beautiful Costa Smeralda and interviews other big sailing personalities as Francesco Bruni and Terry Hutchinson, on Sails in Sardinia.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit Of Yachting, 2025 - - Sydney Hobart Yacht Race
programme.desc: For year now, Rolex sailing competitions across the globe have united the top sailors in different boat classes. From the impressive fast-paced SailGP Grand Prixes to the long-distance Rolex Fastnet Race, there is a different competition for all. Rolex Spirit of Yachting collects the best moments, most emblematic venues and distinguished personalities together under the same show to rewatch the best moments of important sailing competitions all over the world. Get ready to splash into the Giraglia Cup action, jump onboard in the Middle Sea Race or set sail into the unknown Sydney-Hobart Yacht Race.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup, 2014
programme.desc: The second leg of the race goes from New York City to New Port City, Rhode Island. There are two major challenges on this leg: one is getting out of New York Harbour, dealing with the tides and the thicker winds that come off the city, and the other is dealing with the commercial traffic, as it is one of the busiest ports in the world. How will the skippers manage?

programme.title: Iballa - Corazón de Escamas
programme.desc: After more than two decades in the world class of sports and overcoming different personal and sporting challenges of great significance, Iballa Ruano Moreno achieved in 2018 an historical landmark unprecedented in professional sports: winning the world championships in the same year the PWA World Circuit of Windsurf and the APP World Tour of Stand Up Paddle. This milestone never before achieved by an active athlete, highlights the level of dedication and improvement that the Moreno Twins and specifically Iballa Ruano, have been successfully reaping for so many years. However, the journey wasn’t easy. Corazón de Escamas is a short biographical documentary told in the first person and that shows the most intimate part of its history and is dedicated with great affection to the Ruano Moreno family. Dive into the world of this Canarian athlete and find out her inspiring story.

programme.title: Došlo doba da se ljubav proba, film
programme.desc: Završavajući srednju školu, mladić i djevojka nastavljaju ljubav rođenu mnogo ranije u tim istim školskim klupama. Međutim, dolazi do sukoba njihovih porodica: jedni su za svadbeni završetak romantične veze njihove djece, dok su drugi za to da tu vezu prekinu. Priča o sukobu generacija, ali i o životnom dobu u kojem mladalačke ljubavi neminovno prolaze kroz mnoga iskušenja. Nastavak urnebesne komedije "Lude godine".

programme.title: Ciganska magija, film
programme.desc: Ciganska obitelj čini posljednji, očajnički napor da nađe svoj izlaz iz Balkanskog apsurda i nedaća. U njihovoj priči se ogleda univerzalna priča o odbačenima i neprilagođenima, zaboravljenim uličnim herojima koji se pojavljuju u javnosti samo u vijestima ili crnoj kronici.

programme.title: I Bog stvori kafansku pevačicu, film
programme.desc: U specijalnoj atmosferi kafane, u gradiću kraj brane na Đerdapu, rodila se ljubav između lijepe kavanske pjevačice, opterećene prošlošću i ozbiljnog radnika, zaposlenog na gradilištu hidrocentrale. Njihovo vjenčanje značit će i početak surove drame. Ljudi iz njihove sredine, ne mogu zaboraviti njezinu prošlost i zanimanje.

programme.title: I Bog stvori kafansku pevačicu, film

programme.title: Paviljon VI, film
programme.desc: Priča o liječniku u provincijskoj bolnici carističke Rusije koji besciljno provodi dane izgubivši volju i za svoj redovni posao. Jednoga dana u Paviljonu VI, odjeljenju za duševne bolesti, sretne svog bivšeg studenta, buntovnog, nemirnog duha. Privučen za svoje pojmove originalnim idejama svoga pacijenta, liječnik dosta vremena provodi sa njim i prepuštajući se meditacijama, sve više gubi vezu sa stvarnošću. Okolina ga u početku ismijava, da bi na kraju i sam tragično završio život u Paviljonu VI. Ekranizacija istoimene novele Antona Pavloviča Čehova.

programme.title: Direktan prenos, film
programme.desc: Film o snimanju dokumentarnog filma o mladoj uspješnoj atletičarki koja svojim kritičkim izjavama izaziva reakcije politike, a politika je optužuje za doping.

programme.title: Direktan prenos, film
programme.desc: Film o snimanju dokumentarnog filma o mladoj uspješnoj atletičarki koja svojim kritičkim izjavama izaziva reakcije politike, a politika je optužuje za doping.

programme.title: Hajka, film
programme.desc: Ostatak partizanskog odreda razbijenog prevarom, diverzijom skreće na sebe pažnju četnika, koji, umjesto pripremanog napada na Vrhovni štab NOB-a, otpočinju hajku na ranjene, gladne i slabo naoružane partizane skrivene po zemunicama. Ljudi postaju progonjene zvijeri i zvijeri koje progone. U kaosu uništenja, u bespuću, usred divljanja smrti, rađa se sin ranjenog partizana, simbol trijumfa života.

programme.title: Boško Buha, film
programme.desc: Priča o najmlađem heroju revolucije, pioniru i partizanu Bošku Buhi, rodom iz Virovitice. Djetinjstvo njegove generacije okrutno je prekinuo rat, prisilivši njega i njegove vršnjake da prerano sazriju. Ipak, u predahu bitaka i iscrpljujućih marševa, živnula bi opet klica nagona za igrom i nestašlucima, dječja radoznalost, titraji prve ljubavi. Boreći se rame uz rame sa odraslima, ta djeca su se borila i za ostatke svoga djetinjstva.

programme.desc: Kovač i Dara, čija su djetinjstva puna nesreće, upoznaju se u sirotištu i vežu jedno uz drugog. Deset godina kasnije slučajno se susreću kao tinejdžeri. Kovač je vođa bande a Dara živi sama u svom vlastitom svijetu. Kovačeva banda zapliće se u sve ozbiljnije ilegalne poslove. Odani različitim gangsterima i lovljeni od strane korumpiranog policajca, njihove mladenačke iluzije se rasplinju a povratak nazad čini se gotovo nemogućim.

programme.title: Ortaci, film
programme.desc: Priča o malim ljudima koji svoju egzistenciju pokušavaju osigurati na periferiji velikog grada, u miljeu tržičnog "podzemlja", sumnjivih privatnih inicijativa, sitnih prevaranata i nerealnih ambicija. U taj svijet stiže mladić iz provincije sa namjerom da studira. Ali, umjesto studija, on se upušta u sumnjive poslove sa svojim zemljacima, probisvjetima, doživljavajući razne zgode i nezgode u potrazi za lakom zaradom.

programme.title: Ljubi, ljubi, al glavu ne gubi, film
programme.desc: Dok Marija i Boba, nastavljajući svoju ljubav, provode ljeto na omladinskoj radnoj akciji, njihove roditelje zahvataju "lude godine" i "seksualna revolucija". Vrhunac nastaje kada se u život tate Žike, Bobinog oca, poslije kratkog flerta sa Marijinom majkom, umiješaju dvije mlade Njemice. Doznavši za to, Marija i Boba nastoje da urazume svoje "zabludjele" roditelje i da ih vrate na pravo mjesto. Urnebesna komedija, nastavak filmova "Lude godine" i "Došlo doba da se ljubav proba".

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024: Andy Milne & Unison, Fusion
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the ensembles presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is American pianist and composer Andy Milne’s trio Unison. With over three decades of experience, Milne, a protégé of legendary jazz pianist Oscar Peterson, has collaborated with notable figures including Ravi Coltrane, Andrew Cyrille, Sekou Sundiata, Avery Brooks, and Cassandra Wilson. Beyond jazz, Milne is recognized for classical compositions and his contributions to film and television scores. At jazzahead!, Milne’s trio Unison delves into the fusion of texture and groove. Andy Milne (piano) appears with Andrew Peck (bass) and Nate Winn (drums).

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Caixa Cubo, World
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. One of the ensembles appearing at jazzahead! 2022 is Caixa Cubo. This long-standing trio from São Paulo, Brazil, consisting of Henrique Gomide (piano), Noa Stroeter (double bass, electric bass) and João Fidele (drums), has been playing together for over a decade. Caixa Cubo presents a cool contemporary twist to Brazil’s infectious 1970s grooves and adds a welcome new chapter to the samba-jazz tradition as a whole.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla, Latin
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. This episode is all about the Habanera Duo, which sprung from a meeting of minds between flutist Marc Grauwels and accordion player Christophe Delporte, around their shared passion for the Argentine tango and the music of Ástor Piazzolla. After hearing how well their instruments blended, these two musicians founded the Habanera Duo. The duo offers the audience an eclectic repertoire that is simultaneously refined and audacious. Expect a beautiful hodgepodge of classical music and jazz, inspired by composers ranging from Piazzolla to Gioacchino Rossini.

programme.title: Sing Jazz, Singapore, Modern
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind’ was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Summer Night Music - Love Conquers All, World
programme.desc: In Summer Night Music - Love Songs, artists from all over the world contribute their favourite love songs to an unusual and exciting event uniting classical, jazz, and world music. Among the classical musicians are the Gewandhaus Orchestra, cellist Mischa Maisky, and The King’s Singers. Other world stars include jazz vocalist Dee Dee Bridgewater and flamenco cantaora Mayte Martin. The variety of musicians and genres appeals to a wide audience, aiming to create a grand open-air atmosphere that every music lover will remember.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Blue Waters, Concert
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis: Legacy, Modern
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz. Today’s broadcast was recorded at the Amsterdam BIMhuis. Teus dedicates his compositions to his all-time heroes Jarmo Hoogendijk, Woody Shaw, Christian Scott, Roy Hargrove and Eric Vloeimans. This performance is based on his second album ‘Legacy’.
